strings.JNR_KEYWORD_SIXTHSENSE: <style=cKeywordName>Sixth Sense</style><style=cSub>If you would take a lethal attack, instead <style=cIsUtility>dodge</style>, <style=cIsUtility>cleansing debuffs</style> and becoming <style=cIsUtility>invincible</style> for 3 seconds</style>
strings.JNR_KEYWORD_IMMOVABLE: <style=cKeywordName>Immovable</style><style=cSub><style=cIsUtility>Immune to knockback</style> and any other effects that may move you against your will.</style>
strings.JNR_KEYWORD_IGNITION: <style=cKeywordName>Ignition</style><style=cSub>While ignited, your greatsword hits deal an extra <style=cIsDamage>150% base damage.</style>
